# Manual edge fixture

`edge-session.mdx` is generated QA data, excluded from the content collection and production search.
It covers a teacher-only session, absent Heydari/GPT, two recordings, no timestamps or repository,
long title/code, seven prerequisites, five concept links and sixteen changelog entries.

For a local audit, copy it to `src/content/docs/tuesday/session-99.mdx` only if that path is unused,
then build + preview. Check at 320px and desktop widths, keyboard toggles and empty selection.
Remove only that temporary copy afterwards and rebuild. Never publish the fixture as a real class.
